home.an-ai-first-language-and-framework-: An AI-first language for turning your ideas into applications. Pure business logic, a history of every change, and the essentials already built in.
home.most-applications-only-remember-whe: Most applications only remember where things ended up. NeoHaskell remembers how they got there. Every change is recorded as an event, giving you a history you can follow, replay and build on.
home.trace-an-unexpected-result-correct-: Trace an unexpected result. Correct a mistake without erasing the past. Rebuild your queries from the same history when your application evolves.
home.more-freedom-to-build-fewer-ways-to:
More freedom to build.
Fewer ways to break things.
home.your-business-logic-stays-pure-it-c: Your business logic stays pure. It cannot quietly write to a database, call a service or change a file. The language checks that boundary, so you and your agent can change one decision without hidden side effects.
home.an-http-server-for-your-app-an-mcp-: An HTTP server for your app. An MCP server for AI tools. Switch the transport with one line of configuration and keep the business logic you've already built.
home.the-frameworkcomes-with-the-languag:
A language with
the essentials built in
home.less-assembly-more-application-the-: Less assembly. More application. The pieces you would usually choose, connect and maintain are designed to work together from the start.
home.your-ideas-your-agent-a-shared-way-:
Your ideas.
Your agent.
A shared way to build.
home.give-your-agent-a-framework-it-can-: NeoHaskell gives your agent a consistent structure to follow. Its skills for Claude Code and Codex guide the work from the behavior you want to the checks that verify it.
home.describe-your-feature-and-the-rules: Describe your feature and the rules it needs to follow.
home.customers-can-cancel-an-order-befor: "Customers can cancel an order before it ships."
home.let-your-agent-connect-the-pieces: Let your agent connect the pieces
home.business-logic-api-frontend-and-tes: Business logic, API, frontend and tests, built around the same model.
home.review-the-behavior-run-the-checks-: Review the behavior, run the checks and make the next change with context.
home.build-the-ideayou-keep-thinking-abo:
Build the idea
you keep thinking about.
home.neohaskell-build-with-ai-keep-contr: NeoHaskell: Build with AI. Keep control.
home.a-safer-foundation-with-room-to-gro: A safer foundation, with room to grow
meta.neohaskell-is-an-ai-first-language-: NeoHaskell is an AI-first language. Build with your agent, keep a history of every change, and get APIs, authentication, PostgreSQL and file storage built in.
meta.an-ai-first-language-and-framework-: An AI-first language with pure business logic, recorded history and the essentials built in. Build your next application with your AI agent.
capability.a-shared-project-structure-an: A shared project structure and sensible defaults. Spend your time on what makes your application different, not on wiring it together.
capability.api-documentation-comes-from-: API documentation comes from your command and query types. As your application changes, its contract changes with it.
capability.let-users-connect-their-accou: Let users connect their accounts from other services. NeoHaskell handles authorization flows, token storage and refresh.
capability.give-your-events-and-query-da: Give your events and query data a durable home. Use PostgreSQL through the same storage interfaces your application already knows.
capability.accept-uploads-and-store-gene: Accept uploads and store generated documents, with ownership, validation and access control built in.
capability.connect-an-identity-provider-: Connect an identity provider and define who can do what. Authentication and access policies work together across your application.
visual.web-applications-and-ai-agents-sh: Web applications and AI agents share the same NeoHaskell business rules and event history, connected to storage and services
visual.example-shop-history-twelve-mugs-: Example shop history: twelve mugs added, one ordered, then the order cancelled. All three events remain recorded and the stock returns to twelve mugs.
visual.pure-business-decisions-are-isola: Pure business decisions are isolated from database, network and file effects, which NeoHaskell handles separately
visual.http-for-web-and-mobile-clients-a: HTTP for web and mobile clients and MCP for AI tools connect to the same application logic
language.label: Select language
lesson.four-vertical-slices-form-two-cha: Four vertical slices form two chapters, Place order and Cancel order. Each chapter contains a state-change slice and a state-view slice. The mug-shop screen sends a place-order command. Acceptance records Order placed. The stock query reports two available mugs to the order screen. Cancelling before dispatch records Order cancelled, and the stock query reports three again.
lesson.replaying-recorded-events-from-ze: Replaying recorded events from zero stock: receiving three mugs gives three available, placing an order for one leaves two, and cancelling that order restores three.
lesson.a-customer-orders-one-of-three-av: A customer orders one of three available mugs. The order is confirmed and two mugs remain.
lesson.command-order-one-mug-decision-th: Command: order one mug. Decision: three are available, so accept. Event: an order for one mug was placed.
lesson.starting-with-three-mugs-one-reco: Starting with three mugs, one recorded order for one mug gives two query answers: two mugs available and one confirmed order.
lesson.change-shared-code-and-revisit-it: Change shared code and revisit its callers
lesson.conceptual-plot-of-added-slices-b: Conceptual plot of added slices beside stable contracts. Each new behavior adds a similar block of work, keeping total effort close to linear. This is an intended pattern, not a measurement.
lesson.conceptual-plot-of-changing-share: Conceptual plot of changing shared behavior in place. Later changes require increasing rework in existing behavior, marked R. The curve shows rising effort per change, not measured data.
lesson.open-the-full-size-neohaskell-ide: Open the full-size NeoHaskell IDE screenshot
lesson.neohaskell-ide-showing-the-orders: NeoHaskell IDE showing the Orders feature, Place order and Cancel order chapters, four slice columns, and the connected command, event, and query declarations.
